title: Unified Uncertainty Quantification Framework Bridging Noisy Quantum Backends Across Variational Quantum Algorithms and Quantum Signal Processing
summary: We present an uncertainty quantification (UQ) framework for application level benchmarking and characterization of noisy quantum backends. The framework compares two workload classes under one statistical pipeline: noisy intermediate scale quantum (NISQ) variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) and Quantum Singular Value Transformation (QSVT) based Green's function reconstruction. For the VQA branch, we evaluate ten benchmark families spanning chemistry, optimization, simulation, compiling, linear solving, partial differential equations, metrology, error correction, tomography, and channel…
